verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Deepgram serves an llms.txt at developers.deepgram.com with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. Every docs page is also available as clean Markdown by appending .md, which a second probe of the Voice Agent page confirmed, and an OpenAPI spec is served too. missing for 10: evidence of the full content and depth of the llms.txt index (e.g., an llms-full.txt or complete Voice Agent coverage), and independent user corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append .md to the page URL.
